verdict.rationale: Extend's data-handling docs describe automatic retention policies whose default length varies by billing tier and can be configured to fit the customer's policy. They also document zero-data-retention options, including ZDR with AI subprocessors, configurable at the workspace level, and the pricing page lists zero data retention. The evidence is first-party only and thin on mechanics. Missing for 10: documented API/endpoint for explicit on-demand deletion of files or runs, detail on retention configuration granularity and tier defaults, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
